scope: Binary C1-C12 and endpoint connectivity only; resource/nonlinear/full-deployment validation remains C07/C08

association_enumeration.fixture: 2 users, 2 visible satellites, one GS, access/egress capacities1 each
association_enumeration.derivation: Each user needs one access and one egress; capacities require a permutation in each pool; 2!*2!=4.

placement_enumeration.fixture: 1 user, 1 stage, 2 hosts, 2 compatible instances per host; connected graph
placement_enumeration.derivation: C7 permits exactly one of four compatible assignment bits; C8/C9 determine activation.

joint_objective.fixture: 1 user, 2 stages, 2 hosts, one GS; access/egress visible at both satellites; placement type-compatible
joint_objective.note: Algebraic test objective only; no STARS objective is introduced by C06.

gateway_correction: One (satellite,GS) pair per user globally; literal one-pair-per-satellite conflicts on two satellites. Egress capacity counts user flows over all GS choices once per satellite; access pool is separate.
activation: Two users sharing one slice/function/instance give eligible occurrence bound2 and activation count1. Same instance ID at different hosts gives different activation keys. Zero eligible type forces activation0. Overhead charging is C07.
unreachable_segments: O-ENDACCESS: access a, hosts[b,b], egress b
O-ENDINTERNAL: access a, hosts[a,b], egress b
O-ENDEGRESS: access a, hosts[a,a], egress b
unreachable_fixture: Isolated nodes a/b; only a sees user and only b sees GS. Each fixed candidate must be infeasible inside SCIP; adding bridge a-b at100000m makes it discretely feasible. No resource/SLA claim.
domain_proof: Omitted alpha/xi correspond only to invisible edges (C2/C5 require0). Beta creates only stage-compatible existing (type,id,host) instances. All compatible hosts, including zero-CPU and multi-hop hosts, remain. Unreachable product variables are omitted together with explicit endpoint-sum<=1 rows; every reachable pair including identity is retained. No nearest-host or capacity pruning.
